summary_source.positioning: Private kindergarten "Erich Kästner" is a place where the happiness and development of every child are paramount.
teaching_approach: The program is adapted to the age characteristics of the children and is implemented through engaging, game-based and creative methods that encourage their active participation and personal development.
student_experience: Children will have the opportunity to learn and perform fun and entertaining children's songs in both English and Bulgarian.
Children will get acquainted with the richness of Bulgarian folklore by studying traditional dances.
Children will enter the world of a foreign language in a fun and natural way through songs, games, stories and interactive activities.
Children will get acquainted with the energy and rhythms of Latin American music through fun and dynamic dances such as salsa, merengue and bachata.
Children will develop their fine motor skills by using pencils, pastels, brushes and other art materials.
Children will learn basic colors and shapes, which will support their cognitive and emotional development.
community_signals: Our team - Your new big family
differentiators: A place inspired by the fairy tales of Erich Kästner and the magic they bring.
A place where the happiness and development of every child are paramount.
